mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.role_code, r.role_name, r.status FROM grant_table gt INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = gt.role_id WHERE gt.subject_type = #{subjectType} AND gt.subject_id = #{subjectId} ORDER BY r.role_code

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.gender, u.employee_no, u.status FROM grant_table gt INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = gt.subject_id WHERE gt.role_id = #{roleId} AND gt.subject_type = 'USER' ORDER BY u.username
SELECT d.id, d.dept_code, d.dept_name, d.status FROM grant_table gt INNER JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = gt.subject_id WHERE gt.role_id = #{roleId} AND gt.subject_type = 'DEPT' ORDER BY d.dept_code
SELECT p.id, p.post_code, p.post_name, p.status FROM grant_table gt INNER JOIN sys_post p ON p.id = gt.subject_id WHERE gt.role_id = #{roleId} AND gt.subject_type = 'POST' ORDER BY p.post_code
